sourceTitle: George Washington Carver Peanut Recipes: No. 2, Peanut Soup Number Two
sourceText:
George Washington Carver Peanut Recipes: No. 2, Peanut Soup Number Two
By: Barnaby Dorfman
Published: Thursday, December 17, 2009 - 8:04pm

Ingredients




1/2 pint roasted peanuts, grind or mash real fine
1 quart of milk
1/2 teaspoon salt
1 saltspoon pepper
1 small onion, minced very fine
1 bay leaf
1 stalk of celery, chopped very fine or a saltspoon celery seed.
1 tablespoon corn starch

Preparation

1 Cook for 15 minutes. Great care must be exercised to keep from burning. 2 Moisten 1 tablespoon of corn starch in a quarter cup of cold milk; add to the soup; stir until thick and smooth; strain through a fine sieve, and serve with peanut wafers.

About


From George Washington Carver's famous bulletin: "How to Grow the Peanut and 105 Ways of Preparing it for Human Consumption."
